speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).

Given the massive lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and CD20-positive biopsy results, I recommend proceeding immediately with staging studies including a PET-CT scan to assess the full extent of the disease. Do you have any history of autoimmune conditions or exposure to specific chemicals?
